Senator Nagle, Representative Crafts, and the members of the Transportation
Committee,
I come to you today to present LD 290. This request was given to me by
constituent trying to solve a problem that exist in our communities. Municipalities throughout the state are responsible for the paperwork, seizure, holdings, and all
other aspects that come along with vehicle violations. Municipalities are not
reimbursed in any way, if the individual is found guilty. This creates a costly burden to municipalities throughout our great state, which is not being reimbursed Our municipalities are already struggling enough and do not need to deal with this undue burden.
When it comes to individuals breaking the law, this 15% reimbursement would
help with the financial loss of the communities for the processing of individuals Court appearances in all other related items. I ask that you support this bill to give
some much needed relief to our already burdened municipalities.
Thank you for your time and I will take any questions.

House District 138 Cornish, Limington, Buxton (Part) & Hollis (Part)
